title: dactylorhiza aristata
intro: Dactylorhiza aristata, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid or aristate-coiled orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza aristata include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve cough and cold symptoms, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
